name: NDW BLE Gateway · ESP32-C3
description: A LoRaWAN gateway whose radio is Bluetooth LE: it hears the frames NDW BLE meter fleet advertises, forwards them to MeterFax as a LoRa Basics Station over WiFi, and advertises the network's downlinks back into the meters' receive windows. Any ESP32-C3 with 4MB of flash. Its WiFi, server, trust file and token are programmed over USB after flashing, from flash.meterfax.com.
$comment2: An Arduino build, not ESP-IDF: boot-app0.bin is the Arduino core's otadata image, the same 8KB of 0xff the IDF builds call ota-data-initial.bin, and needed for the same reason — the console writes with eraseAll false.
